title: [review] provisioning.py:534: provision_node returns be
description: Docstring claims step 4 is 'Verifies the ACK' but the method returns the seed at line 585 immediately after sending encrypted seed via send_message(), without waiting for or verifying the ACK. The ACK verification happens asynchronously via render_post/_handle_br_post, but this method's contract suggests it completes the full provisioning flow. Either add ACK verification (await receive_message() + br_session.decrypt_ack()) or correct the docstring.
